custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২৫ কাটা যাবে।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১) Our task had been submitted before sunset. (Active)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: We had submited our task before sunset.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: We have submitted our task before sunset.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: We submitted our task before sunset.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: We had submitted our task before sunset.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Passive Voice: Our task had been submitted before sunset.
Active Voice: We had submitted our task before sunset.  (অপশন 'ঘ')

• Past perfect tencse যুক্ত Passive Voice কে Active Voice করার নিয়ম - 
→ প্রদও বাক্যটি paasive form- এ রয়েছে। 
→ এখানে, object = us ঊহ্য রয়েছে। 
→ সম্পূর্ণ sentence টি হচ্ছে - Our task had been submitted before sunset by us.

→ active voice- এ রূপান্তর করার সময় প্রথমে 'by' এর পরে object = us, active voice- এ subject = We রূপে বসবে।
→ by উঠে যাবে।
→ passive voice- এ auxiliary verb = had been, active voice- এ subject = We- এর পর 'had' হিসেবে বসবে। 
→ 'had' এর পর principal verb = submit এর past participle form = submitted বসবে।
→ passive voice এর subject = Our task, active voice- এ object হিসেবে বসবে।
→ before sunset = extension হিসেবে active voice- এ বসবে।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ২) Change the given sentence from direct to indirect speech: Saniya said to her sister, "Will you go there?"
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: Saniya told her sister if she will go there.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: Saniya asked her sister if she would go there.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: Saniya asks her sister if she would go there.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: Saniya asked her sister if she will go there.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Direct Speech: Saniya said to her sister, "Will you go there?"
Indirect Speech: Saniya asked her sister if she would go there.

• Narration এর ক্ষেত্রে,
Sentence টি Interrogative sentence এ থাকলে,
→ Reporting verb টি  ask, inquire of, want to know, demand, wonder ইত্যাদিতে পরিবর্তিত হয়।
→ Sentence টি Interrogative এর পরিবর্তে Assertive এ পরিণত হয়।

• Interrogative sentence এ যদি W/H question word না থেকে যদি auxiliary verb দ্বারা শুরু হয় তখন সেই বাক্যটিকে পরিবর্তনের নিয়ম:
→ Reporting verb এর subject বসে।
→ Tense অনুযায়ী ask/ inquire of বসে।
→ Object বসে (যদি থাকে)।
→ if/ whether বসে।
→ reported speech এর subject বসে।
→ reported speech এর verb বসে।
→ বাকি অংশ।

Structure: Reporting verb এর subject + Tense অনুযায়ী ask/ inquire of + Object + if/ whether + reported speech এর subject + reported speech এর verb + বাকি অংশ।

Source: Advanced Learner's by Chowdhury & Hossain.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৩) Achieve the goal without deviating from the outlined strategy and objectives. (Passive)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: Let the goal being achieved without deviating from the outlined strategy and objectives.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: Let the goal to achieve without deviating from the outlined strategy and objectives.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: Let the goal be achieved without deviating from the outlined strategy and objectives.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: Let the goal should achieve without deviating from the outlined strategy and objectives.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Active Voice: Achieve the goal without deviating from the outlined strategy and objectives.
Passive Voice: Let the goal be achieved without deviating from the outlined strategy and objectives.

• শুধু মূল verb দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া imperative sentence এর active voice থেকে passive করার নিয়ম:
→ প্রথমে Let বসবে;
→ Active voice এর object টির subject রূপে বসবে;
→ be বসবে;
→ মূল verb এর past participle বসবে।

• Structure: Let + object টির subject হয় + be + মূল verb এর past participle + extensions.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৪) Change the narration: "Are you ready?" the doctor said to her children.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: The doctor asked her children if he was ready.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: The doctor asked her children if they were ready.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: The doctor asked her children if it was ready.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: The doctor asked her children if they were being ready.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Direct Speech: "Are you ready?" the doctor asked her children.
Indirect Speech: The doctor asked her children if they were ready.

• Direct  Speech থেকে Indirect Speech করার নিয়ম হচ্ছে:
→ Reporting verb টি past tense এ থাকলে indirect narration করার ক্ষেত্রে reported speech ও past tense হবে।
→ WH শব্দ না থাকলে reported speech-এর পূর্বে 'if' বা 'weather' বসে + sub+ verb + object.

Structure: Reporting verb এর subject + Tense অনুযায়ী ask/ inquire of + Object + if/ whether + reported speech এর subject + reported speech এর verb + বাকি অংশ।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৫) Has anybody answered your question? (Passive)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Active Voice: Has anybody answered your question?
Passive Voice: Has your question been answered? (অপশন 'ঘ')

• Interrogative sentence + present perfect tense এর Active Voice কে Passive Voice করার নিয়ম - 
→ প্রদত্ত বাক্যটি interrogative sentence- এ রয়েছে।
→ interrogative sentence কে assertive sentence- এ রূপান্তরিত করে এরপর ওই assertive sentence- এর voice change করে তাকে পুনরায় interrogative- এ পরিবর্তন করলে আমরা passive voice (উত্তর) পেতে পারি।

• interrogative sentence → assertive sentence → passive voice → interrogative sentence
→ Interrogative sentence = Has anybody answered your question?
→ Assertive sentence = Anybody has answered your question.
→ Passive voice = Your question has been answered by anybody.
→ Interrogative sentence = Has your question been answered? (by anybody ঊহ্য রয়েছে)

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৬) Every disaster-affected victim has been compensated by the government. (Active)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: The government had compensated every disaster-affected victim.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: The government has compensated every disaster-affected victim.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: The government has been compensating every disaster-affected victim.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: The government have been compensating every disaster-affected victim.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Passive Voice: Every disaster-affected victim has been compensated by the government. 
Active Voice: The government has compensated every disaster-affected victim.  (অপশন 'খ')

• Present perfect tense যুক্ত Passive Voice কে Active Voice করার নিয়ম - 
→ প্রদও বাক্যটি paasive form- এ রয়েছে। 
→ active voice- এ রূপান্তর করার সময় প্রথমে 'by' এর পরে object = the government, active voice- এ subject রূপে বসেছে।
→ by উঠে গেছে।
→ passive voice- এ auxiliary verb = has been, active voice- এ subject = The government- এর পর 'has' হিসেবে বসেছে। 
→ 'has' এর পর principal verb এর past participle form = compensated বসেছে।
→ passive voice এর subject = Every disaster-affected victim, active voice- এ object হিসেবে বসেছে।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৭) The man refused him admittance. (Passive)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: Admittance is refused to him by the man.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: Admittance was refused by the man to him.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: He was refused admittance by the man.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: Admittance is refused him by the man.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Active Voice: The man refused him admittance.
Passive Voice: He was refused admittance by the man. (অপশন 'গ')

• Past indefinite tense যুক্ত Active Voice কে Passive Voice করার নিয়ম - 
→ প্রথমে object = him, passive voice- এ subject = He রূপে বসেছে।
→ Passive voice- এ subject = He এর পর active voice- এর tense অনুসারে auxiliary verb = was বসেছে।
→ 'was' এরপর principal verb- এর past participle form = refused বসেছে।
→ refused এরপর admittance = optional agent হিসেবে বসেছে।
→ এরপর by বসেছে।
→ 'by' এরপর active voice এর subject = The man, passive voice এ object = tha man রূপে বসেছে।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৮) Mostofa said, "Let the girl say whatever he likes." (Indirect Speech)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: Mostofa said that the girl might say whatever she liked.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: Mostofa said that the girl might say whatever he liked.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: Mostofa told that the girl might say whatever he likes.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: Mostofa said the girl might say whatever he likes.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Direct Speech: Mostofa said, "Let the girl say whatever he likes." 
Indirect Speech: Mostofa said that the girl might say whatever he liked.

• 'Let' যুক্ত বাক্যকে Direct speech থেকে Indirect speech করার নিয়ম:

→ Direct speech থেকে Indirect speech এ রূপান্তরিত করার সময় Let দ্বারা প্রস্তাব না বোঝালে Reporting verb এর পরিবর্তন হয় না।
→ Inverted comma উঠে গিয়ে  that বসে + Reported Verb এর subject পুনরায় বসে + might + reporting speech এর মূল verb থেকে শেষ পর্যন্ত হয়।

→ Structure: Subject + প্রদত্ত  Reporting verb + object যদি থাকে + that + Reported speech এর subject + might + reporting speech এর মূল verb থেকে শেষ পর্যন্ত।

Example:
Direct Speech: Anwar said, "Let him say whatever he likes."
Indirect Speech: Anwar said that he might say whatever he liked.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৯) Change the voice: "The novel was acclaimed as a masterpiece."
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: We acclaimed the novel as masterpiece.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: The novel was acclaimed as a masterpiece.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: The novel was being acclaimed as a masterpiece.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: People acclaimed the novel as a masterpiece.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Passive Voice: The novel was acclaimed as a masterpiece.
Active Voice: People acclaimed the novel as a masterpiece.

• আমজনতার সাথে Related কাজ হলে Subject হিসেবে People বসাতে হবে।
→ প্রথমে People বসাতে হবে।
→ মূল Verb এর ঠিক আগের 'be' Verb 'was' বাদ যাবে।
→ মূল Verb এর ঠিক আগের 'be' Verb এর গঠন অনুযায়ী মূল Verb বসবে।
→  Subject টি Object হবে।
→ বাকি অংশ বসবে।

More Example:
Passive Voice: He was called wise.
Active Voice: People called him wise.

Source: Advanced Learners Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১০) Ashmani said to me 'Let us go out for a walk'. (Make it indirect)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: Ashmani asked me to go out for a walk.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: Ashmani proposed to me that we should go for a walk.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: Ashmani suggested me to we go out for a walk.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Direct Speech: Ashmani said to me, "Let us go out for a walk."
Indirect Speech: Ashmani proposed to me that we should go out for a walk.

• Direct speech এ Let এর পরে us থাকলে দুইভাবে  Indirect speech এ পরিবর্তন করা যায়,

• Structure 1: Subject + propose/suggest + that + they/we + should = reported speech এর মূল verb থেকে শেষ পর্যন্ত।
→ reporting verb এর subject, third person হলে that এর পর we বসে এবং Subject, first person হলে that এরপর they বসে।

Example:
→ Direct Speech: Abir said, "Let us go out for a walk."
→ Indirect Speech: Abir proposed to me that we should go for a walk.

• Structure 2: Subject + propose/suggest + object + gerund (reported speech এর main verb এর সাথে ing) + বাকি অংশ।
Example:
→ Direct Speech: Abir said, "Let us go out for a walk."
→ Indirect Speech: Abir suggested going out for a walk.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১১) Identify the correct passive form of the sentence. "Who showed you the wonders of astronomy?"
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: By whom were you shown the wonders of astronomy?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: The wonders of astronomy were showed to whom?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: By whom were the wonders of astronomy you shown?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: By whom were the wonders of astronomy showed you?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Active Voice: Who showed you the wonders of astronomy?
Passive Voice: By whom were you shown the wonders of astronomy?

- Active Voice-টি Past Indefinite Tense- এ আছে। এবং এটি Interrogative Sentence.

Who-যুক্ত Sentence-কে Interrogative করার নিয়ম:
- Who-এর পরিবর্তে প্রথমে By whom বসে +
- Tense ও Person অনুযায়ী Auxiliary Verb বসে +
- Objectটি Subject হয় +
- অনেক সময় Tense অনুযায়ী, কর্তার পরে be/being/been বসাতে হয় + 
- মূল Verb-এর Past Participle হয় +
- প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন বসে।

More Examples:
Active Voice: Who inspired you to pursue a photography career?
Passive Voice: By whom were you inspired to pursue a photography career? 

Active Voice: Who introduced you to classical music?
Passive Voice: By whom were you introduced to classical music?

Source: Advanced Learner’s Communicative English by Chowdhury and Hossain.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১২) Identify the correct indirect speech. He said, "How delightful the taste of this dish was!"
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: He exclaimed that the taste of this dish was delightful.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: He exclaimed that the taste of this dish was very delightful.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: He exclaimed that the taste of this dish had been very delightful.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: He exclaimed that the taste of this dish was being very delightful.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Direct Speech: He said, "How delightful the taste of this dish was!"
Indirect Speech: He exclaimed that the taste of this dish had been very delightful.

• Exclamatoey Sentence- এ ক্ষেত্রে Narration এর নিয়মানুযায়ী,
→ Direct speech এ reporting verb (said) past tense এ থাকায়, Indirect speech এ reporting verb 'exclaimed' হবে। 
→  direct speech এ 'was' থাকায় reported speech- এ 'had been' হবে।
→  exclamatory sentence এ how থাকলে assertive sentence এ very বসে।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question:
১৩) Choose the passive form of the sentence:
Turn off the lights before you go to sleep.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: Let the lights to turn off before you go to sleep.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: Let the lights being turned off before you go to sleep.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: Let the lights be turned off before you go to sleep.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: Let the lights should be turn off before you go to sleep.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Active Voice: Turn off the lights before you go to sleep.
Passive Voice: Let the lights be turned off before you go to sleep.

• শুধু মূল verb দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া imperative sentence এর active voice থেকে passive করার নিয়ম:
→ প্রথমে Let বসবে;
→ Active voice এর object টির subject রূপে বসবে;
→ be বসবে;
→ মূল verb এর past participle বসবে।

• Structure: Let + object টির subject হয় + be + মূল verb এর past participle + extensions.

More Example:
Active Voice: Complete the task without any delay.
Passive Voice: Let the task be completed without any delay.

Source: Advanced Learner's HSC by Chowdhury & Hossain.

Sentence টি Interrogative sentence এ থাকলে,
→ Reporting verb টি  ask, inquire of, want to know, demand, wonder ইত্যাদিতে পরিবর্তিত হয়।
→ Sentence টি Interrogative এর পরিবর্তে Assertive এ পরিণত হয়।

• Interrogative sentence এ যদি W/H question word না থেকে যদি auxiliary verb দ্বারা শুরু হয় তখন সেই বাক্যটিকে পরিবর্তনের নিয়ম:
→ Reporting verb এর subject বসে।
→ Tense অনুযায়ী ask/ inquire of বসে।
→ Object বসে (যদি থাকে)।
→ if/ whether বসে।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৫) You should open the wine about five hours before you use it. (Passive)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: Wine should be opened about five hours before use.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: Wine should be opened by you five hours before use.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: Wine should be opened about five hours before it is used.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: Wine should be opened about five hours before you use it.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Active Voice: You should open the wine about five hours before you use it.
Passive Voice: Wine should be opened about five hours before it is used. (অপশন 'গ')

• প্রদত্ত বাক্যটির দুইটি অংশ।
• 'before' conjunction দ্বারা দুইটি principal clause যুক্ত রয়েছে। দুইটি clause কেই আলাদা ভাবে passive voice- এ রূপান্তর করতে হবে।
• about five hours = object agent হিসেবে অপরিবর্তিত অবস্থায় বসেছে।

প্রথম অংশ:
→ Active Voice: You should open the wine.
→ Passive Voice: Wine should be opened.

দ্বিতীয় অংশ:
→ Active Voice: You use it.
→ Passive Voice: It is used.
